newsitem.title: INDIA: Two Indian officers suspended over virginity tests.
newsitem.headline: Two Indian officers suspended over virginity tests.

text.p: Two medical officers found guilty of conducting virginity tests on a nursing student were suspended by the local government in India's southern state of Andhra Pradesh, officials said.
The student was seeking admission to a nursing course at a hospital in the town of Visakhapatnam, officials said.
The health minister in the Andhra Pradesh government ordered an inquiry into the incident after it created an uproar in the local assembly.
